The right room, with a reason

Find estimated room matches for a request, or help administrators spot demand peaks and review event relocation options.

Availability is estimated
Checks the supplied class and event schedules. It checks the live prototype reservation store, but does not connect to the university booking system.

Describe the room you need

Hard requirements remove rooms that cannot work. The rest are ranked by fit.

The request file represents demand and has no guaranteed assigned room. Availability comes from schedule checks only.

Recommended rooms

The trained Ridge Regression ranker sorts rooms after capacity, facilities, accessibility, schedule and event constraints are checked. It learned a synthetic allocation rubric from the supplied synthetic data; it has not learned real student room preferences. A live booking system is still needed to confirm a room.

Admin sign in

Sign in with the admin credential saved in this browser.

Prototype access gate: this standalone demo stores a local credential and expires the admin session after 30 minutes. The page and synthetic data remain in the browser, so this is not production security. Use server-side authentication and authorization before connecting real campus data.

Admin workspace

Live demo requests

Requests are stored by the reservation service. Approving one blocks that room/time for all visitors using this service.

Live demo limitation: requests are persisted by this prototype server and shared by browsers connected to it. They are not sent to campus staff or written to the university booking system.

When requests peak

Room requests grouped by requested weekday and start hour.

Counts come from synthetic request dates. They show submitted demand, not unmet demand alone.

Lowest scheduled class hours

Weekly class hours by room. Events are excluded; this is not total occupancy.

Events to review

Low attendance can prompt a review, but does not by itself mean an event should move.

Relocation suggestions check expected attendance, class conflicts and other events in this synthetic schedule. They do not account for event setup or live booking changes.
